scope: Synthetic operational orders; separate from the historical UCI finance mart
amount_unit: Integer pence; historical field names retain the conventional _cents suffix
date_semantics: order_day is the explicitly supplied UTC business date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD

fields.order_id: Positive integer primary key; key equals envelope row ID
fields.refund_cents: Integer 0..gross_cents; cumulative refund on the current order

metrics.paid_orders: Count of present orders whose current status is paid, grouped by order_day
metrics.gross_cents: Sum of current gross for paid orders
metrics.refund_cents: Sum of current cumulative refund for paid orders
metrics.net_cents: Sum of gross minus refund for paid orders

deletion: A source deletion removes that order from current reporting; original events remain in cdc_events
publication: Current orders, daily mart, event audit and consumed offset commit in one DuckDB transaction
schema_change: Unknown or missing row fields fail closed; migrate the contract and dependent consumer together
source_completeness: New sink requires offset 0 and contiguous uncompacted history. Retention gaps require a new snapshot.
freshness: No ongoing service or freshness SLO claimed; bounded integration exercise only
lineage_kind: Curated dependency map, tested against the source contract; not SQL-inferred lineage
